subject: Renewal: Procurement portal onboarding & capacity increase
messages:
From: Lisa Danvers <lisa.danvers@acme-health.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme-health.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity increase)

Hi Dylan,

We're preparing for our July 1 renewal and plan to expand our seat count by ~30% across ingest and inference. Procurement needs a quick onboarding refresh so we can re-run the vendor portal checks and submit PO changes. Can you confirm the minimal set of documents and who on your side will complete the portal questionnaire?

Specifically we need:
- Updated SOC 2 attestation (Type II preferred)
- W-9 or tax form for our finance team
- A short amendment to the current SOW/quote reflecting +30% seats and term change to 12 months
- Point of contact who can complete the portal entry (vendor admin account)

We also have a tight procurement portal timeline: once the vendor portal record is created, it takes 48-72 hours for their automated checks to clear. Please advise so we don't miss the renewal window.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Danvers
Director, Procurement | Acme Health
procurement@acme-health.com

Attachments: none

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Danvers <lisa.danvers@acme-health.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity increase)

Hi Lisa — thanks for the heads up. Happy to move this quickly. Next steps from our side:

1) I'll drop SOC 2 and W-9 into this thread (attached) and create a vendor admin account in your portal by EOD today.
2) Priyom, can you prepare an amendment quote with +30% capacity and a 12-month term? Mark it as "Amendment_Quote_v2.xlsx" and include a brief line item summary for PO entry.
3) Marissa, can you confirm operational impact for the capacity bump and whether any migration window is needed?

Lisa — once we have the amendment PDF and the vendor portal record, please share the portal link and we'll complete their questionnaire. If Acme requires a PO before portal clearance, Priyom can fast-track a provisional invoice.

I'll attach the documents I have now.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII.pdf (pdf), W9-Redwood.pdf (pdf)

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity increase)

On it — draft attached.

Summary (Amendment_Quote_v2.xlsx):
- Baseline renewal: 12 months (Jul 1 2026 - Jun 30 2027)
- Capacity: +30% seats across inference pool (breakdown per environment included)
- One-time setup for capacity increase: $2,400
- Monthly delta: $6,900
- Suggested provisional invoice: cover first month of delta to secure capacity during portal checks

I've also included a short amendment clause text that legal can stitch into the existing SOW. If Acme needs net-60 terms, note that in reply and I'll route to finance.

Attaching Amendment_Quote_v2.xlsx and a DocuSign stub link for signature flow.

Priyom Das
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments: Amendment_Quote_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
Related link: https://www.docusign.com/some-doc-link

From: Lisa Danvers <lisa.danvers@acme-health.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme-health.com, Tom Hale <tom.hale@acme-health.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity increase)

Thanks — that looks good. Portal note: vendor admin needs to create the vendor profile and submit three fields (tax id, primary contact, bank remit info). Do you need us to invite the vendor admin, or will Redwood create the profile?

Also: Our procurement policy requires SOC 2 and a signed amendment before portal approval. We can start the portal entry now but will hold the final PO until the amendment is signed.

Tom (cc) will be the technical contact for validation; he may ask for a short runbook about how the capacity increase will be applied in prod.

Lisa

Attachments: none

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Danvers <lisa.danvers@acme-health.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity increase)

Hi Lisa — quick operational note from CS: the +30% can be applied live with no downtime if scheduled during a weekday low-traffic window (we recommend 01:00–04:00 PT). We'll provide a one-page runbook for Tom that covers KV warming, cache priming, and validation steps. I'll attach the runbook PDF to the DocuSign envelope after signature.

Rishi — FYI on the proposed commercial delta; if we offer any credit for multi-term commit, please advise.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: none

Lisa — once we have the signed amendment, Dylan will complete the vendor portal account creation and we can submit the provisional invoice as discussed. Expect the DocuSign link from Priyom within the hour.
